features: Analog Turbo HD, single HD analog (TVI) output over coax/BNC — NOT an IP camera

release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2CE10DV0T-LPXTS is an analog Turbo HD 2MP ColorVu 3.0 two-way-audio Smart-Hybrid-Light mini bullet with HikAI-ISP, IR up to 25m, white light up to 25m, built-in mic and speaker, and a red/blue strobe plus audible alarm; verified against DS-2CE10DV0T-LPXTS_Datasheet_20260714.pdf.
